source.source_boundary: MPAT=CONTINUOUS denotes a fixed-calendar-length mission that starts on time even below its minimum, suspended until enough systems are attached. The v1.0.0 continuous probe was rejected by native converter #335 because it inherited A03's TFOUT/TFRET fractions; this corrected version clears those fields only on continuous inputs. A separate fixed four-hour control tests the shared normal path; the one-aircraft child tests initial shortage only. Mid-mission loss, replacement and resumption need further native evidence.

delta.fixed_from_A03: Change mission duration 2 to 4 hours, simulation/report end 36 to 16 hours, description and inherited unit label; keep two deployed aircraft and NOS=MNOS=2.
delta.continuous_from_fixed: Change MissionType.MPAT default FIXED to CONTINUOUS, clear TFOUT/TFRET as required by native converter #335, and change description.
delta.shortage_from_continuous: Change only SystemDeployment.QTYPS 2 to 1 and descriptive labels; keep MissionType.NOS=MNOS=2, MPAT=CONTINUOUS and hour-8 launch.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Each input has its own immutable guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source/raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip.

The fixed and continuous two-aircraft controls convert with zero errors, start their single mission at hour 8 and conclude at hour 12; their per-aircraft events and 16-hour report are compared without claiming generic equivalence.

The one-aircraft continuous child is evaluated for on-time start, explicit suspended state and the native hour-12 stop; native report and log decide whether any aircraft is allocated or operating, whether a success is recorded and whether terminal readiness is one. No unsupported success/failure status is presumed.

For all three runs, reconcile 32 aligned half-hour system and stock bins, mission state/exposure, no random failure or maintenance, inventory demand, and terminal state; classify any conversion warning.
An independent reviewer replays exact input and parent deltas, sealed raw artifacts, three event/report ledgers and limits without importing the author validator.
limits: This three-run group cannot establish mid-mission loss, replacement, resumption or paused-system exposure; those are required follow-on A05 slices before full A05 method completion.
One fixed seed, one formation, no failures, repairs, PM, external resources, GUI visual observation or cross-engine equivalence.
